scope: Research proposal only, not implemented or promoted; justification from first80 TRAIN only and primary sources. No additional policy evaluated. Historical validation/test already seen and cannot tune against them.

structuralChanges.change: Each raw signal receives one modeled channel, instead of repeated category votes
structuralChanges.note: Channels still economically correlated; deduplication removes exact repeated position/upDays/candle votes but does not imply independent signals. Do not invert trend/volume just to fit weak negative return correlations.

structuralChanges.change: Separate upside event and downside/realized payoff, rather than treating technical strength as probability
structuralChanges.note: Independent probability heads must preserve logical event inclusion; actual model calibration required, no selected-score rescaling.

structuralChanges.change: Fit directions/scales/weights only using chronological maturity-aware folds inside first80 training dates
structuralChanges.fixedEvaluationPrinciple: Forecast fold date cannot use any training row with D5 maturity >= forecast date; freeze one formula before reused val/test replay; no threshold grid. Training fold performance is not a fresh holdout.

structuralChanges.change: Apply a monotonic extension/distress risk penalty and retain original observed downside outcomes
structuralChanges.formulaFamily: Base reward-risk index=100*(0.10*p(touch10 AND D5net>0))/(0.10*p(touch10 AND D5net>0)+0.05*p(loss5)+0.05*p(loss10)+0.003); final=min(100,max(0,round(Base*exp(-lambdaExtension*extensionATR-lambdaDistress*longTrendDistressATR))))
structuralChanges.constraints: lambdaExtension,lambdaDistress>=0; fit/freeze only training temporal folds; index is not event probability. Existing earlier full-feature reward-risk variant failed, so a deduplicated risk-aware version requires new evidence rather than promotion by analogy.

recommendation: Current evidence supports correcting ranking contract, identifying duplicate/extension problems, and honest outcomes. It does not justify choosing new numeric weights or guaranteeing three high-score profitable picks daily. No production-ready score improvement established.

primaryReferences.finding: Choosing signal signs/weights among many combinations can severely overfit. Limits proposal to one frozen family and training-only folds; paper does not validate this score.
Weekly diversified reversal net returns depend on liquidity and turnover costs; cannot justify flipping short-day trend direction or +10% Korean three-pick claims.
Current close/trailing12month high predicts medium-horizon diversified momentum in original study. Existing range-position is different, and 5day long-only +10 requires direct evidence.
Volume and momentum interact by stage; prior average share turnover differs from current volume ratio. Cannot assume ever-larger current volume monotonically improves next5day profit.
